memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But just as all the good things the Lord your God has promised you have come to you, so he will bring on you all the evil things he has threatened, until the Lord your God has destroyed you from this good land he has given you. If you violate the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the Lord's anger will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from the good land he has given you." — Josh 23:15-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This is a hard word, and Joshua does not soften it. The same God who faithfully kept His good promises will just as faithfully carry out His warnings. If Israel breaks the covenant and turns to other gods, judgment will come. God's faithfulness cuts both ways — He is true to His warnings as well as His blessings.

We should not rush past the difficulty here. This is covenant language, spoken to Israel under the covenant God made with them at Sinai. The blessings and curses were part of that specific agreement, and Israel's later history shows these words came true. It is a real and serious warning.

Yet even here we can see God's character clearly: He is utterly consistent and takes covenant faithfulness seriously. His warnings are not empty threats; they flow from His holiness. Sin against a holy God is never a small thing.

For us who live under the New Covenant, this points us straight to Christ. We too have broken faith with God, and we deserved His judgment. But Jesus bore the curse we earned, taking it upon Himself on the cross (Gal 3:13). The consistency of God that once threatened us now secures us in Christ, who took the judgment in our place. Do not treat God's holiness lightly — but run to the Saviour who satisfied it for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you take the holiness and warnings of God seriously?
2. How does it move you that Christ bore the curse you deserved?
3. What does it mean to live under grace without treating sin as small?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Holy God, thank You that You are faithful and true in all Your words. Thank You that Jesus bore the curse I deserved. Help me never to treat Your holiness lightly. Amen.
